mentions.name: Solo AI RPG (Claude as DM)
mentions.description: This app is a solo AI RPG where Claude acts as Dungeon Master, running as a Claude Artifact. It is built on a world bible from the builder's D&D group's sessions 20 years ago, aiming to recreate the feel of those sessions and the players' absurdities as young 20-somethings so it can be shared with gaming buddies.
mentions.source_excerpt: Building a solo AI RPG (Claude as DM) using a world bible from my D&D group's sessions 20 years ago, so I can share with my gaming buddies.  Very basic game running as an Artifact in Claude.  Trying to nail the feel of the sessions down as well as the players' absurdities as young 20-somethings.
mentions.author: binarysolo
